messages:
jordan: Quick follow-up from last night's P-504 page — we need to do an after-action review (30-45m) to capture mitigation timeline, action items, and customer impact notes. Who can host? Prefer within 48h.

alex: I can host but only Tue 9-11am PT. I have a customer sync at 1pm PT.

priya: I'm available Wed 8-11am PT or Thu afternoon. I worked the routing fallback fix. Happy to lead if nobody else can.

lee: Tue afternoon is fine for me (2-4pm PT). I took the initial on-call for the incident so I can present the timeline.

emily: I handled the deploy rollback. I can join any slot and prep the rollback notes.

jordan: Thanks — looks like options spread across Tue/ Wed/Thu. Main goal: 1) capture timeline + log snippets, 2) agree owners for runbook fixes, 3) customer comms blurb for CSMs.

sre-ops-bot: Incident P-504 — Sev 2 — pages started 2023-11-01T02:13Z, mitigation completed 2023-11-01T02:47Z, impacted customers: 3 (billing API errors), runbook used: routing-fallback-v2. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/P-504

alex: If we pick Tue 9:30am PT I can host but need someone to present the KV cache sizing part (Priya/Lee?).

priya: I can cover KV cache sizing and routing fallback. If alex hosts, I'll present engineering details.

lee: I'll put together a short timeline slide with logs and alert graphs.

jordan: Ok propose this: Tue 9:30am PT host=alex, presenter=priya+lee, notes=emily. If anyone objects, speak now. Otherwise I'll post an invite and pre-read.

emily: :+1: that works for me. Can we include the small customer impact template in the invite body? It's easier for CSMs to copy paste.

jordan: yes — good call. Draft snippet below.

jordan: ```Customer impact (short): On 2023-11-01 02:13 UTC a routing fallback was triggered causing 5xx errors for the billing API for ~34 minutes for 3 customers. Mitigation: rollback of routing change + cache warmup. Customers affected: <list>. Current status: mitigated; long-term fix planned. Contact: eng-support@redwood.ai```

priya: tiny ask — add the mitigation timeline (start/rollback/fully recovered) in the pre-read as bullet points so SREs can correlate with alerts.

alex: good call. I'll add timeline and error-rate graphs. Lee — please include the alert rules that fired.

lee: will do. Also adding the snapshot of the routing config we rolled back.

jordan: I'll create the calendar invite now for Tue 9:30am PT — 30m. Agenda: 1) Timeline & evidence (10m) 2) Root cause hypothesis + RCA owners (10m) 3) Action items & owners (10m).

jordan: Quick note on owners: - runbook update -> priya - alert tuning -> lee - customer comms blurb -> emily - follow-up verification -> alex (two-week check)

priya: fine with owners. I'll add a short doc with suggested runbook changes before the meeting.

emily: I'll draft the customer comms template and post to the thread so we can edit live.

alex: I'm going to mark the incident as 'requires follow-up' in the tracker and attach the invite.

sre-ops-bot: Calendar invite created by jordan for P-504 after-action review Tue 2023-11-07 09:30 PT. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/abc123

jordan: Thanks. If anyone can't make it, add availability or propose a swap. We'll record and post the notes.

lee: one conflict — I'm out Tue 9:30-10:00 PT for an external meeting. If pushback, we can slide to 10am or priya can present timeline.

alex: Hmm — prefer not to move. Priya already agreed to present details; Lee your alert slides are additive, not required to run the meeting. Could you upload slides early?

lee: ok I can upload slides by EOD.

jordan: Perfect. Last bits: please add any log snippets or queries to the pre-read doc (I'll attach). Also add any follow-up items as separate TODO comments so we can export them to the action tracker.

priya: will do.

emily: Posted draft customer blurb to the pre-read doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/d/incident-P504-comms

jordan: Great — seeing thumbs-up from hosts. I'll close scheduling here. See you Tue. :calendar: 

alex: :thumbsup:

lee: :thumbsup:

priya: :thumbsup:

emily: :thumbsup:

jordan: (last) Created action list in tracker and linked to meeting notes. Closing out scheduling thread.
